reviews.comment: You will not understand anything he is saying, and you don't need to. Memorize all the slides and you are golden. I never once listened to what he was saying in class, I just memorized the lecture slides the best I could. The tests are like 80 MCQ long, but don't stress they are easier this way, they are very easy if you know the slides.

He is a very nice and understanding teacher. Lectures are very interesting. Attendance is important because there are short quizzes every day. Reading the textbook and doing the exam reviews helps a lot with the midterm and final. He is very passionate about geophysics and that shows in how he teaches.

Extremely caring professor. Has a noticeable accent, but easy to understand. 341 could a very difficult class by the material, but he made the lecture exams very forgiving, with only a few work out problems. The labs he assigns are very hard, but are also graded very forgivingly. You can tell he LOVES geophysics, and is excited to teach. Great guy!

Super nice guy but can't understand anything he says. Tests are way too detailed for an entry course, but he provides test reviews that if you memorize EVERYTHING on them you'll ace the tests. Cumulative final. In class quizzes give you +3pts on your final grade if you go to class SO GO. HW easy. Don't buy the book, never opened mine and got an A.

Duan is a nice professor and is very passionate about the subject, but his accent made this class extremely difficult. His lectures were very detailed for an into course, and each test contains 6 or more chapters( only 2 midterms & final). This was my hardest class this semester. I do not recommend this if you're looking for an easy science credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Solid and straightfoward class. Professor has a thick accent and is hard to understand but his power-points are easy to follow along. Tests aren't too bad but require a good amount of studying for a high B or A due to lots of memorization of terms. Attendance isn't required but there are daily in class grades (really easy), overall a solid class.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: His accent is so thick I didn't understand a single thing. That's not even the worst part: a cumulative final which had 20 chapters! Even though a lot of people requested to make the finals non-cumulative, he denied. The tests have 70+ questions, and each test is at least 6 chapters. I am not even a geology major yet I study more geology.

Before I say anything else, Duan is a great person. He is very kind and cares about his students. However, he has a very strong Chinese accent. It is very hard to understand sometimes. Luckily the tests are straight off the pp and he gives a little extra credit. You will have to study. i am a freshman business major and this is my hardest class.

He's hard to understand at times but he's very passionate about what he does and clearly cares about it. In class pop quizzes, if you're paying attention to the current lecture it's easy 100s. A lot of work and detail for a non-major class though. Tests were very detailed from the textbook.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Not a hard class. If you go you get a chance to take extra credit quizzes in class. Easy hw grades are 15%, 2 test worth 21% each, & final worth 43%. Test are long, but formatted very simple. If you study and memorize everything on lecture slides you will get an A. He is hard to understand but he usually reads straight off his power points.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Duan is a super nice and friendly guy. However, this class is HARD. If geology isn't your thing, I'd advise you to not take this class with him. He does make well-organized powerpoints and offers extra credit, though. The material is pretty in-depth and there is sooo much material, it gets overwhelming. Not a bad guy, but a really hard class.

goes into minute details for a non-major class, tests are very detailed. Nice guy but don't take unless youre willing to study every day. Did offer extra credit, but not clear on grading yet. Only two test, and a cumulative final that goes into a lot of detail. I would not recommend to anyone who is not planning on majoring in geology.
reviews.ratingTags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY
